IS: 9391 -1980 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 




SPECIFICATION FOR 

STRAIGHT COUPLING ASSEMBLIES FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for straight coupling assemblies used 
in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Types 

2.1 Type A — Covers the assembly for taper male stud coupling bodies for 4 mm outside diameter 
of tube, 

2.2 Type 5 — Covers the assemblies for male stud coupling bodies. 

2.3 Type C — Covers the assemblies for straight coupling bodies. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Assembly Details 

4.1 Type A — A taper male stud coupling consists of ferrule ( conforming to IS : 8802-1978 ' Speci- 
fication for ferrules for oil-hydraulic couplings ' ), coupling nut ( conforming to IS : 8803-1978 ' Speci- 
fication for coupling nuts for oil-hydraulic couplings ' ) and taper male stud coupling body ( conform- 
ing to IS : 9392=1980 ' Specification for taper male stud coupling body for oil-hydraulic couplings ' ). 

4.2 Type B — A male stud coupling consists of ferrule ( conforming to IS : 8802-1978 ), coupling nut 
( conforming to IS : 8803-1978 ) and male stud coupling body ( conforming to IS : 8801-1978 ' Speci- 
fication for male stud coupling body for oil-hydraulic couplings ' ). 

4.3 Type C ■■- A straight coupling consists of ferrule (conforming to IS : 8302-1978 ), coupling nut 
(conforming to IS : 8803-1978 ) and straight coupling body ( conforming to iS : 9390-1980 'Speci- 
fication for straight coupling body for oil-hydraulic couplings ' ). 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 (Part I )-1978 
• General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems : Part I General '. 

6. Designation - A straight coupling assembly Type B of light series L for outside diameter of tube 
6 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Straight Coupling BL6 IS : 9391 



Adopted 21 January 1980

Note — In case of Type B assemblies, the stud end details are as per Type A of IS : 8805 ( Part I )- 
1978. The Type B assemblies having Type B stud end may be supplied if specified. The designation shall 
then be for example: 

Straight Coupling BL 6 IS : 9391— B 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards: 

BS : 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes 
Part 1 Heavy series ( metric ) and Part 3 Light series ( metric ) 

DIN 2353 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions, complete unions and survey-
